chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad and Aḥmad, the two sons of al-Ḥasan, from their father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
When a woman menstruates, her husband may approach her as he wishes, so long as he avoids the place of blood.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman, here meaning the wife in menstruation
key_terms.مَوْضِعَ الدَّمِ: the place of the blood, i.e. the site of menstrual bleeding

ai.seo_question: What is permissible for a husband with his wife when she is menstruating in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning intimacy with a menstruating wife. It permits forms of marital approach while prohibiting contact with the place of menstrual blood.
